news.title: More than half the electricity feeding America's largest data centers comes from gas and coal
news.summary: A Harvard study published in Nature Sustainability found that 403 US hyperscale data centers produced roughly 25.7 million metric tons of CO2 between May 2024 and April 2025, more than all of Denmark. Over half of their electricity came from fossil fuels. With 2,000 additional facilities planned, the researchers warn of a major climate setback. The article More than half the electricity feeding America's largest data centers comes from gas and coal appeared first on The Decoder .

news.title: New LoRA Adapter Lifts Qwen3.8 Coding Success From 39% to 65%
news.summary: Hugging Face released Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted, an Apache-2.0 LoRA adapter trained with reinforcement learning for the pi coding agent. It lifts SWE-bench Pro hard-51 pass@1 from 39.2% to 64.7% and Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 39.5% to 55.8%. The post New LoRA Adapter Lifts Qwen3.8 Coding Success From 39% to 65% appeared first on MarkTechPost .

news.title: SID AI Releases SID-2 Agentic Search Model With 0.720 NDCG Swarm Mode
news.summary: SID AI released SID-2, an agentic search model trained with reinforcement learning. A single agent reaches 0.585 NDCG in 3.11 seconds, and a 12-agent SID-2 Swarm scores 0.720 NDCG, above GPT-6 Astra on SID’s benchmark. The post SID AI Releases SID-2 Agentic Search Model With 0.720 NDCG Swarm Mode appeared first on MarkTechPost .

news.title: Anthropic Adds Code Mode to Claude Code: Claude Now Chains Tool Calls in JavaScript
news.summary: Anthropic has added Code Mode to Claude Code v2.1.323. The experimental feature lets Claude write JavaScript that chains Bash, Read and Edit calls in 1 step, and keep talking while long commands run. The post Anthropic Adds Code Mode to Claude Code: Claude Now Chains Tool Calls in JavaScript appeared first on MarkTechPost .

news.title: Quoting Daniel Stenberg
news.summary: During the time these agents converted 185,000 lines of C code into 340,000 lines of Rust code (I counted), we merged over 300 commits in the actual curl project. We actually improved curl during these a little more than three weeks. A little over 200 bugfixes actually. 200 bugfixes that none of those rust rewrites have. We also fixed a few vulnerabilities. In another month we have done another 200 and maybe fixed a few more vulnerabilities. Will these clones keep up? — Daniel Stenberg , Actual
